    Tiles

    14 rows

    One character is just the player. More, and route trainers wear the rest — each block is the frame width × columns across and four rows tall, laid left to right then down.

    Make any place look the way you want. The quickest start: stand somewhere in your region and tap Customise this place — its map is copied here for you to change. Each tile knows what it is (water, a wall, tall grass…), so painting a tile brings its terrain with it; the Terrain layer changes any square by hand.

    Paint the building with your tiles first, then put its door on the bottom row of the building, where the player walks in.

    Tile tap a tile below to paint with it

    Tiles

    Tap tiles to give them the terrain picked above. A ● marks a guess the game made that you have not checked yet.

    Battle sprites load from an online library. If your device cannot reach it, supply a sprite sheet here and it is used instead — stored on the device, so it works offline afterwards.

    Sprites are read in dex order, left to right then down: cell 1 is #1, cell 2 is #2, and so on.
